data.name: A Taste of LA: Half Day Tour of the BEST of Los Angeles
data.headline: Half-day 5.5-hour VIP-style sightseeing tour of Los Angeles visiting Beverly Hills, Santa Monica Pier, The Grove/Farmers Market, and Griffith Observa​
data.description:
Experience the best of Los Angeles in a streamlined half-day VIP-style sightseeing tour. Travel in a new climate-controlled 2025 luxury mini-coach with an entertaining driver guide who shares local stories and fun facts. Visit four convenient stops—Beverly Hills and Rodeo Drive, Santa Monica Pier, The Grove and Farmers Market for lunch, and Griffith Observatory for Hollywood Sign views—while using a free multilingual audio guide available in 11 languages for added context. The tour begins and ends at the Hollywood Visitor Center for easy access to Hollywood highlights.
Your ticket also includes a complimentary self-guided Hollywood Walk of Fame walking tour, and our team will assist you with setup during check-in so you can explore at your own pace.
data.highlights:
* See LA’s most iconic landmarks in a convenient half-day format
* Travel in brand-new 2025 luxury, climate-controlled coaches
* Multilingual audio guide available in 11 languages for a personalized experience
* Entertaining local driver guide sharing stories and fun facts
* Four curated stops allowing time to explore, eat, and take photos
data.itinerary:
1. Beverly Hills & Rodeo Drive — 30 minutes: Beverly Hills sign and Rodeo Drive sightseeing.
2. Santa Monica Pier — 45 minutes: Walk the pier and ocean views.
3. The Farmers Market & The Grove — 60 minutes: Lunch and shopping time.
4. Griffith Observatory & Hollywood Sign Views — 30 minutes: Panoramic views and photo opportunities.

data.booking_notes:
Thank you for choosing A Taste of LA: Half Day Tour of The Best of Los Angeles! 

###Reminders:
This Tour is on a New Comfortable Climate Controlled Luxury Bus that stops @ multiple locations where you will disembark the bus to explore, take pics, get food, shopping, etc - Top-rated guides will give you local tips, gossip, history and the best stories. We recommend checking the weather and planning accordingly. The tour will be 5.5 hours with traffic permitting. Please keep in mind LA traffic is one of a kind lol. 

###Additional Information:
- Starts on the The Hollywood Visitor Center @ 7044 Hollywood Blvd. 

Stops:
- Beverly Hills @ Rodeo Drive - 30 Min Stop
- Santa Monica - 45 minute stop
- The Grove - 60 Minute stop (Shopping & Lunch)
- Griffith Observatory - 30 minute Stop
- Tour ends back on Hollywood Walk of Fame

***We recommend parking at one of the two parking garages at 7021 Hollywood Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90028, which is a short walk from our departure location. 

On the day of your tour, we ask that your entire group checks in 15 minutes prior to your departure time inside The Hollywood Visitor Center to ensure the tour can leave on time. 

We recommend checking our FAQ’s section if you have questions: 

https://hollywoodbustoursla.com/frequently-asked-questions/

Looking for things to do while you are in Los Angeles? Check out our 40 Fun Things To Do in LA: 

https://hollywoodbustoursla.com/fun-things-to-do-in-hollywood/

Meet us at 7044 Hollywood Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90028
data.check_in_details: Meet at the Hollywood Visitor Center, 7044 Hollywood Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90028. Please arrive 15 minutes before scheduled departure. Check-in staff will assist with downloading and logging into the audio guide app.
data.special_requirements: Guests should arrive 15 minutes before departure to ensure timely departure. Check-in staff will assist with app download and login.
data.restrictions: Inside Griffith Observatory is closed on Mondays; the tour will still visit the exterior and viewpoint. Tour duration is approximate and subject to traffic conditions.
data.disclaimers: Tour duration is approximately 5.5 hours, subject to traffic. Griffith Observatory interior access may be closed on certain days (closed on Mondays); in that case the tour visits the exterior viewpoint and provides extra time at Beverly Hills. The tour begins and ends at the Hollywood Visitor Center. Guests are advised to review lunch and shopping options at The Grove and Farmers Market to maximize stop time.
